name: School Garden
shortDescription: A green classroom of plants, flowers and a small pond.
detailedDescription: The school garden is an outdoor classroom where students learn about plants, insects and the environment. The eco club cares for flower beds, vegetable patches and a small pond, and uses the garden for nature walks and science observations.

hotspots.title: Eco Club
hotspots.description: The eco club plants, waters and looks after the garden, and runs campaigns on saving water and reducing waste.

hotspots.title: Garden Pond
hotspots.description: The pond is home to water plants and visiting birds – a favourite spot for nature observation.
